_: TEMPLATE for a new flow or task. Copy this file to flows/<id>.json (for example flows/H3.json) and fill everything in. The board skips files whose name starts with an underscore, so this file itself is ignored.
Every key that starts with an underscore is a note for you; the generator ignores it. Keep or delete it.
JSON rules: every text in double quotes, a comma after every field except the last, decimals with a dot (0.5).

A step is one line with: naam (what happens), wie (who), soort (kind), uren (hours), and optionally start, eind, meetpunt and afhankelijkheden. The field names are Dutch on purpose; see the field table in README.md.
_id: short unique name, a capital letter plus a digit; must equal the file name (H3.json)
_naam: what readers see on the board
_soort: flow = repeats and is measurable per ticket | taak = happens once (a task)
_doel: one sentence: what does it deliver and for whom
doel: One sentence: what it delivers and for whom.
_groep: free text shown under the name on the board
_prio: whole number. Lower = higher on the board; duplicates allowed. 5 is a fine start.
_tekening: path to an SVG you put in a drawings folder, for example tekeningen/my-flow.svg. Empty string = no drawing yet
_frequentie: only for soort flow. per = werkdag | week | maand (workday, week, month). Remove this line for a task.
_heeft_nodig: other flows or tasks that must exist first. Bare id or with a reason: ["H1", {"id": "H2", "waarom": "the inventory must exist"}]
_afhankelijkheden: everything this flow leans on: ids from afhankelijkheden.json. If something is missing, add it there first.
_versies: at least one version. A second version (for example the future way of working) is a new block after the first, separated by a comma.

versies._status: huidig = current | ontwerp = design | vervallen = retired
versies.bron: estimate; still to be checked against ticket data

onderhoud._: time needed to keep this version running; 0 is fine. Optional: stappen (own maintenance steps, same shape as below), afhankelijkheden (list of ids), kennis (list of person ids).

_stappen: the timeline of one ticket, from start to end, one line per step
wie = a person id (mensen.json), a dependency id (for example an external party) or a role from config.json (owner, agent, subagent, queue, unknown). Do not know? unknown.
soort = mens (a human works on it) | werk (an agent or script works on it) | wacht (nobody of ours works on it, waiting)
uren = time of this step per ticket, decimals allowed (0.5)
start / eind = (optional) the moment the step starts and ends, in plain words
meetpunt = (optional) which system already records that moment: {"systeem": "ticket-system", "veld": "creation-time"}; systeem "geen" (none) = only found through an interview or a log
afhankelijkheden = (optional) ids of what this one step leans on; shown as chips under the step
